title: An algebraic extension is purely inseparable over the separable closure of the base in it
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $K/k$ an algebraic field extension [def-pc-field-extension] (every element of $K$ is a root of a nonzero polynomial with coefficients in $k$). Let $K_s\subseteq K$ be the separable algebraic closure of $k$ in $K$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure], i.e. the set of elements of $K$ separable over $k$. Then $K_s$ is a subfield of $K$ containing the image of $k$; the extension $K_s/k$ is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]; and $K/K_s$ is purely inseparable in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]: if $k$ has characteristic $p>0$, then for every $\alpha\in K$ there is an integer $n\ge0$ with $\alpha^{p^n}\in K_s$, and if $k$ has characteristic $0$, then $K_s=K$.

source.place: Fields, Lemma 030K (fields-lemma-separable-first, line 1704) and its proof; that the separable elements form a subextension is Fields, Lemma 09HC (fields-lemma-separable-elements, line 1435)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line per clause: `separableClosure F E` (Mathlib/FieldTheory/SeparableClosure.lean:83, an IntermediateField, so a subfield containing F) is K_s; instance `separableClosure.isSeparable` (SeparableClosure.lean:151, @[stacks 030K]) gives Algebra.IsSeparable F K_s (separable algebraic); instance `separableClosure.isPurelyInseparable` [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E] (PurelyInseparable/Basic.lean:481, @[stacks 030K]) gives IsPurelyInseparable K_s E; in characteristic p, `isPurelyInseparable_iff_pow_mem` (PurelyInseparable/Basic.lean:211, with ExpChar p) turns it into the power condition; in characteristic 0, E/K_s is separable (char 0 fields are perfect: Algebra.IsSeparable of PerfectField) and `IsPurelyInseparable.surjective_algebraMap_of_isSeparable` (PurelyInseparable/Basic.lean:158) gives K_s = E.
